title: Cross-border joint high net load warnings: research code and derived evaluation data
description: Research code and author-derived evaluation data for synchronous high net load monitoring in Germany-Luxembourg, France and Belgium, with DK1/DK2 transfers. Portable reconstruction recomputes evaluation from released hourly probabilities, event indicators and forecast-only review plans, then regenerates block-bootstrap contrasts and publication figures. No raw provider MW series, weather grids, price series, fitted models or unpublished manuscript are deposited. Software is MIT licensed; author-derived data are CC BY 4.0 with retained third-party terms and attribution as detailed in DATA_LICENSES.md. This is delayed historical replay, not independently validated live operational availability. Version 1.0.0 is prepared for an author-created release; no DOI is asserted here.
